workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've carefully compared our lists. Unfortunately, there are NO overlapping time slots where all four partners are free. Here's the comparison:

- Tuesday: Priya/Marcus free 13:00-14:00 and 16:30-17:00; Elena/David free 09:00-10:00 - no overlap
- Wednesday: Priya/Marcus free 15:00-16:00; Elena/David free 13:00-14:00 - no overlap

I'm reporting this as infeasible since there is no time next week when all four partners can meet.

infeasible.reason: After comparing all four partners' calendars, there are no overlapping 30-minute time slots next week (Nov 16-20) when all four partners are simultaneously available. Priya and Marcus's free times do not overlap with Elena and David's free times on any day.
